preconditions.description: The length of the paths n is between 2 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(move in {'N', 'E', 'S', 'W'} for move in path1)
preconditions.description: Each character in the first grid path is one of 'N', 'E', 'S', or 'W'.

preconditions.expression: all(move in {'N', 'E', 'S', 'W'} for move in path2)
preconditions.description: Each character in the second grid path is one of 'N', 'E', 'S', or 'W'.
The length of the first grid path is n - 1.
The length of the second grid path is n - 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if can_reach_end(path1, path2) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if it is possible to move both marbles to the end of their respective paths, otherwise 'NO'.
